recognize_zh: 真皮內密集的淋巴細胞浸潤呈強烈紅色膜狀免疫染色，包圍但不侵犯染色陰性的附屬器上皮結構；此張為 T 細胞抗原免疫染色，標記名稱未標示，需配合 TCL1 與 T-PLL 臨床背景判讀。
features: Dense, sheet-like dermal infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Strong, crisp membranous red chromogen staining in virtually all infiltrating cells
Negative (blue counterstained) adnexal/ductal epithelium serving as internal control
Perivascular and periadnexal distribution with cuffing around the epithelial structure
Uniform staining intensity suggesting a monotonous population
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen; specific marker not indicated) on a skin biopsy shows a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate with diffuse, strong membranous positivity in nearly all neoplastic cells. The infiltrate surrounds and cuffs a negative adnexal epithelial structure and perivascular spaces. Cytologic detail is limited on this immunostain. In the context of a known T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, the diffuse positivity for a T-cell antigen is consistent with cutaneous involvement (leukemia cutis); TCL1 expression would support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: MF shows epidermotropism with CD4+ cells often losing CD7, whereas T-PLL spares the epidermis and expresses TCL1.
Reactive infiltrates are mixed CD4/CD8 with preserved pan-T antigens and lack TCL1 and clonal TRG rearrangement.
CLL cutis is CD20+/CD5+/CD23+ B cells, not a T-cell antigen-positive population.

stain: IHC: T-cell marker (marker not specified), red chromogen
